svg.aria-label: Map of the AI Concept Atlas: 8 domains — foundations, model architectures, training & adaptation, retrieval & knowledge, agents & orchestration, inference & optimization, multimodal ai, evaluation, safety & reliability — each showing its best-known concepts, arranged around a central hub of 87 concepts encircled by the 7 branches of mathematics they rest on: linear algebra, probability, information, optimization, numerics, graphs, dynamics.
svg.text: AI CONCEPT ATLAS · 87 CONCEPTS · 8 DOMAINS · 38 MATHEMATICAL FOUNDATIONS
